summary.goal: Allow users to @mention agents/users in messages with autocomplete dropdown and visual highlighting
summary.approach: Simple plain-text mentions - @ triggers dropdown populated from presence, inserts '@Name' text, regex-based highlighting on render
in_scope: Typing @ shows dropdown of available users/agents from presence
Arrow keys + Enter to select from dropdown
Escape or clicking away dismisses dropdown
Selected mention inserted as plain text '@Name'
Mentions highlighted visually in rendered messages
Dropdown positioned near cursor in input

acceptance_criteria.description: Typing '@' in MessageInput shows dropdown with users/agents from presence
Dropdown filters as user types after '@'
Arrow up/down navigates dropdown, Enter selects
Escape or blur dismisses dropdown without inserting
Selecting inserts '@Name ' (with trailing space) at cursor position
Messages containing @mentions display mentions with distinct visual style
Dropdown appears near text cursor, not fixed position

steps.title: Create useMentions hook for mention state management
steps.description: Create a hook that manages mention autocomplete state: detecting '@' trigger, tracking query text, filtering candidates from PresenceEntry[], handling selection. This hook encapsulates all mention logic separate from UI.

acceptance_criteria.description: Hook accepts { value: string, cursorPosition: number, candidates: PresenceEntry[] }
Returns { isOpen: boolean, query: string, filteredCandidates: PresenceEntry[], selectedIndex: number }
Returns { moveUp: () => void, moveDown: () => void, select: () => { text: string, insertAt: number } | null, dismiss: () => void }
isOpen becomes true when '@' detected at cursor position (not inside word)
query is the text after '@' until cursor (e.g., 'Hey @Jo|hn' -> query='Jo')
filteredCandidates filters by name.toLowerCase().startsWith(query.toLowerCase())
selectedIndex wraps around on moveUp/moveDown
select() returns '@Name ' text to insert, replacing '@query'

steps.title: Create MentionDropdown component
steps.description: Create dropdown UI component that displays filtered mention candidates. Shows name and entity type (user/agent) with visual distinction. Handles click selection. Positioned absolutely relative to container.

acceptance_criteria.description: Accepts { candidates: PresenceEntry[], selectedIndex: number, onSelect: (index: number) => void, position: { top: number, left: number } }
Renders list of candidates with name and entity type indicator (AI badge for agents)
Selected item has highlight style (bg-bg-elevated or similar)
Click on item calls onSelect with that index
Max height ~200px with overflow-y-auto
Styled per design system: bg-bg-tertiary, border-border-subtle, rounded-lg, shadow
Empty state hidden (parent should not render if no candidates)

steps.title: Add cursor position tracking to MessageInput
steps.description: Enhance MessageInput to track textarea cursor position on every change/selection. Calculate visual position of cursor for dropdown positioning. This is foundational for mention integration.

acceptance_criteria.description: Track selectionStart on onChange and onSelect events
Calculate approximate visual position using hidden mirror element or character measurement
Export cursor position to parent via callback or return value
Position updates on: typing, arrow keys, mouse click in textarea

steps.title: Integrate useMentions and MentionDropdown into MessageInput
steps.description: Wire up the mention hook and dropdown into MessageInput. Handle keyboard events (ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, Escape) when dropdown is open. Insert selected mention text. Pass presence members from props.

acceptance_criteria.description: MessageInput accepts new prop: mentionCandidates: PresenceEntry[]
Typing '@' shows MentionDropdown with filtered candidates
ArrowUp/ArrowDown navigates dropdown (prevents default cursor movement)
Enter selects mention (does not send message when dropdown open)
Escape dismisses dropdown without action
Clicking outside textarea dismisses dropdown
Selection inserts '@Name ' and closes dropdown
Dropdown positioned near text cursor, not fixed

steps.title: Add mention highlighting to MessageContent
steps.description: Enhance the processInlineFormatting function in MessageStream.tsx to detect @mentions and render them with distinct styling. Use regex to find '@Name' patterns.

acceptance_criteria.description: Regex pattern /@\w+/g matches mentions in message body
Mentions rendered with distinct style: text-accent-cyan, font-medium
Mentions inside code blocks are NOT highlighted (code takes precedence)
Multiple mentions in same message all highlighted
Works with existing markdown processing (code, bold, italic, links)

steps.title: Pass presence to MessageInput in MessagingSidebar
steps.description: Update MessagingSidebar to pass presence members to MessageInput for mention autocomplete. The presence data is already available via usePresence hook.

acceptance_criteria.description: MessagingSidebar passes presence.members to MessageInput.mentionCandidates
When presence updates, MessageInput receives updated candidates
Works in both connected and mock mode

steps.title: Add useMentions and MentionDropdown tests
steps.description: Write unit tests for useMentions hook and MentionDropdown component. Test mention detection, filtering, keyboard navigation, and selection logic.

acceptance_criteria.description: Test: '@' at start of input triggers isOpen
Test: '@' after space triggers isOpen
Test: '@' inside word does NOT trigger (e.g., 'email@test')
Test: query filters candidates case-insensitively
Test: moveUp/moveDown cycles through candidates
Test: select returns correct replacement text and position
Test: MentionDropdown renders candidates with correct styling
Test: MentionDropdown click calls onSelect
